title: On the Kelly monoidal structure of $Λ$-sequences and unital operads
summary: Let $Λ$ be the category of based finite sets $\mathbf{n}$ and based injections. We study properties of monoids and modules in $Λ$-sequences under the Kelly monoidal structure. In particular, we show that the forgetful functor from right modules in $Λ$-sequences to right modules in symmetric sequences is an isomorphism.
